locations.name: Materials Yard
locations.apprentice: Gain 3 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
locations.apprenticeZh: 获得共3份泥和/或柴，可任意组合。
locations.shifu: Gain 4 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood. Then you may pay 1 Coin to gain +1 Clay and +1 Wood.
locations.shifuZh: 获得共4份泥和/或柴，可任意组合。然后可支付1铜钱，额外获得1泥和1柴。

locations.name: Potter’s Wheel
locations.apprentice: Pay the Clay cost to form 1 vessel.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付泥费用，成型1件器物。
locations.shifu: Form 1 or 2 vessels. If you form 2 vessels using this Shifu effect, reduce their total Clay cost by 1. Ding's additional vessel is paid for separately and does not count toward the Shifu Potter’s Wheel discount.
locations.shifuZh: 成型最多2件器物。若成型2件，则这2件器物所需的泥总数减少1。

locations.name: Glaze & Decoration
locations.apprentice: Apply a Glaze and Decoration to 1 shaped vessel; pay the Decoration cost.
locations.apprenticeZh: 为1件已成型器物施加1种釉与1种装饰，支付装饰费用。
locations.shifu: Apply Glaze and Decoration to up to 2 shaped vessels; one Decoration applied by this action costs 0 Coins.
locations.shifuZh: 为最多2件已成型器物施釉与装饰；本行动所施加的其中1个装饰费用为0铜钱。

locations.name: Kiln Yard
locations.shifu: Load up to 2 ceramics. If you have at least 1 ceramic in the Shared Kiln, place your Shifu on 1 of your ceramics in the Shared Kiln. After Contributions are revealed and Base Heat is determined, but before the Fire card is revealed, you may move that ceramic to an empty active space in a neighbouring heat zone.
locations.shifuZh: 装窑至多2件陶瓷。若你的共窑中至少有1件己方陶瓷，将师傅放在其中1件上。控火牌揭示并确定基础火候后、火牌揭示前，你可以将该陶瓷移动至相邻火候区（高 ↔ 中 ↔ 低）中的一个空置有效窑位。

locations.name: Commission Market
locations.apprentice: Reserve 1 Main Order. Then gain 1 Clay, 1 Wood or 1 Coin.
locations.apprenticeZh: 承接1张主委托。然后获得1泥、1柴或1铜钱。
locations.shifu: Reserve up to 2 Main Orders, resolving each reservation separately. After each reservation, gain 1 Clay, 1 Wood or 1 Coin.
locations.shifuZh: 最多承接2张主委托，逐张独立结算。每承接1张后，获得1泥、1柴或1铜钱。

locations.name: Guild & Academy
locations.apprentice: Pay the printed Coin cost and take 1 face-up Advanced Tech.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付牌面铜钱费用，取得1个公开进阶技艺。
locations.shifu: Choose 1 discipline and look at the top 2 Techs of that deck, or as many as remain. Then take either 1 face-up Advanced Tech from any discipline or 1 of the revealed Techs, paying 1 Coin less, minimum 0. Put any revealed Tech not taken on the bottom of its deck.
locations.shifuZh: 选择1个技艺类别，查看该叠顶端2个技艺（不足则尽量查看）。然后取得任意类别的1个公开技艺，或其中1个刚查看的技艺，支付费用−1铜钱，最低为0。未取得的已查看技艺放到该叠底。
